Nina Mills was next away, clocking 19:02 to bring the team in 9th, and a now constantly improving Jacqui Smiter enjoyed herself on the final leg, picking off two of the opposition with her 17:56 effort.

And so we stay where we are for another year. Jacqui Smiter has survived her first year as Joint Team Manager and we now set our sights on 1997.
We are always used to seeing Team Manager Jacqui Smiter in action but the third meeting at St. Alban's saw Cynthia James also leading by example.

The jumps, too, gave us some good scores with Julia Cockram taking the senior high jump and pole vault, Jacqui Smiter taking the 'B' high jump and Sabrina Scott notching up yet another long jump victory.

Jacqui Smiter has had a short spell in hospital for a wrist operation. We hope that her recovery is swift and look forward to her teaming up with Cynthia James again this summer to capitalize on our promotion the the Women's Southern League Division Two.
